🔧 Upgradeability & Teardown Analysis

RAM Architecture: 16GB RAM 2x DDR5 SO-DIMM (Upgradeable). ✅ Fully user-upgradeable via standard SO-DIMM sockets. You can pop off the bottom chassis cover with a Phillips #0 screwdriver to install dual-channel kits.

Storage Expansion: 2TB NVMe pre-installed, 1x M.2 2280 PCIe Gen 4. ✅ Standard M.2 NVMe slot(s). Supports aftermarket Gen 4/Gen 5 SSD replacements up to 4TB/8TB per drive.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you upgrade the RAM and SSD on the Lenovo ThinkPad L14 (2021, Intel, AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe)?
The Lenovo ThinkPad L14 (2021, Intel, AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe) features 16GB RAM 2x DDR5 SO-DIMM (Upgradeable) and 2TB NVMe pre-installed, 1x M.2 2280 PCIe Gen 4. RAM is modular via SO-DIMM slots and can be easily upgraded to higher capacities. Storage can be expanded using standard M.2 NVMe PCIe SSDs.
What is the real-world battery life of the Lenovo ThinkPad L14 (2021, Intel, AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe)?
Equipped with a 57 Whr battery, the Lenovo ThinkPad L14 (2021, Intel, AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe) delivers approximately 7.6 hours of real-world continuous web browsing at 150 nits brightness, and approximately 1.3 hours under continuous heavy gaming or 3D rendering load.
How does the Lenovo ThinkPad L14 (2021, Intel, AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU, 16GB RAM, 2TB NVMe) perform in gaming and creative workloads?
Powered by the Intel Core Ultra 9 185H and AMD Radeon 780M / 890M iGPU with 28W Shared power delivery, it scores approximately 18,400 in Cinebench R23 Multi-Core and 3,600 in 3DMark TimeSpy Graphics, averaging ~28 FPS in demanding titles like Cyberpunk 2077 at 1080p Ultra.
